export type EffectiveSetting = {
    key: string;
    revision: string;
} & ({
    state: "ok";
    value: SandboxJson;
    source: SettingSource;
    layers?: SettingLayers;
} | {
    state: "unavailable";
    reason: string;
});

export declare const SETTINGS_CONSEQUENCES: readonly ["reach", "cost", "external", "schedule"];

export declare const SETTINGS_LAYERS: readonly ["project", "personal"];

export declare const SETTINGS_READ_INPUT_SCHEMA: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

export declare const SETTINGS_READ_INPUT_TYPE = "molis.settings.read.request.v1";

export declare const SETTINGS_READ_OUTPUT_SCHEMA: {

                            readonly const: "ok";
                        };

                            readonly type: readonly ["null", "boolean", "number", "string", "array", "object"];
                        };
                        readonly source: {
                            readonly type: "string";
                            readonly enum: readonly ["project", "personal", "provider_default"];
                        };
                        readonly layers: {
                            readonly type: "object";
                            readonly properties: {
                                readonly project: {
                                    readonly type: readonly ["null", "boolean", "number", "string", "array", "object"];
                                };
                                readonly personal: {
                                    readonly type: readonly ["null", "boolean", "number", "string", "array", "object"];
                                };

                                };
                            };

                            readonly additionalProperties: false;
                        };
                        readonly key: {

export declare const SETTINGS_READ_OUTPUT_TYPE = "molis.settings.values.v1";

export declare const SETTINGS_SOURCES: readonly ["project", "personal", "provider_default"];

export declare const SETTINGS_WRITE_INPUT_SCHEMA: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

export declare const SETTINGS_WRITE_INPUT_TYPE = "molis.settings.write.request.v1";

export declare const SETTING_KEY_SCHEMA: {
    readonly type: "string";
    readonly pattern: "\\S";
};

export type SettingConsequence = (typeof SETTINGS_CONSEQUENCES)[number];

export interface SettingEntryDeclaration {
    key: string;
    title: TextRef;
    summary?: TextRef;
    layers: SettingLayer[];
    schema: SandboxSchema;
    consequence?: SettingConsequence[];
}

export type SettingLayer = (typeof SETTINGS_LAYERS)[number];

export type SettingLayers = Partial<Record<SettingSource, SandboxJson>>;

export type SettingSource = (typeof SETTINGS_SOURCES)[number];

export interface SettingsDeclaration {
    entries: SettingEntryDeclaration[];
    read: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
    write: Pick<ActionReference, "capability_id" | "version">;
}

export interface SettingsReadInput {
    keys: string[];
}

export interface SettingsValues {
    values: EffectiveSetting[];
}

export interface SettingsWriteInput {
    key: string;
    layer: SettingLayer;
    change: {
        set: SandboxJson;
    } | {
        inherit: true;
    };
    expected_revision: string;
    request_id: string;
}
